name: dry swabbing
description: use a dry swab applying medium pressure and firmly rotate the swab

name: wet swabbing
description: use a moistened swab applying medium pressure and firmly rotate the swab

name: double swabbing with two swabs
description: first use a moistened swab, then use a second dry swab. Collect the sample applying medium pressure and rotating the swabs

name: double swabbing with single swab
description: first use tha half of the swab that has been moistened, then use the dry side. Apply medium pressure while collecting the sample.
